title: JOVRA Room join challenge (jovra.room.join-challenge/1)
description: The host's answer to a valid join request, sent only after the guest has committed to its key and guest nonce (guestCommitment). hostNonce is fresh CSPRNG output for this attempt; the guest then reveals guestNonce (jovra.room.join-reveal/1) and both screens show the six-digit verification code.
